title: Resolve handoff identifiers against current state
summary: Identifiers in handoffs and design notes can go stale. Before attaching work, status, or tests to a task ID, migration filename, issue, or release number, resolve it against the current source of truth.
ai_value: Helps agents avoid filing evidence under the wrong anchor or following stale migration numbers after rebases and mainline movement.

contexts: a handoff names a task, issue, migration, release, artifact, branch, or other identifier
mainline advanced after a design note chose a numbered filename or slot
an agent is about to write status, tests, docs, or artifacts against a named identifier

trigger_signals.description: The handoff ID was provisional, old, or copied from a previous session.
trigger_signals.agent_interpretation: Resolve it in the tracker or source before using it as the work anchor.

trigger_signals.description: A migration or numbered artifact was planned before rebasing or merging mainline.
trigger_signals.agent_interpretation: Inspect the final directory and tests before recording the identifier.

negative_signals.description: The identifier is immutable and has been verified immediately before use.
The identifier appears only as historical context, not as an execution anchor.

common_wrong_assumptions: A named ID in a handoff is current because it was correct when written.
Migration numbers in design notes survive rebases unchanged.
If the title looks similar, the anchor must be the same work item.

first_checks.check: Resolve the ID in the authoritative current system before attaching artifacts.
first_checks.why: This prevents status or files from landing on the wrong work item.

first_checks.check: For numbered files or migrations, inspect the directory after rebasing and update tests/docs to the final name.
first_checks.why: The final merged identifier is what future agents will search for.

first_checks.check: Record rejected stale IDs when confusion is likely to recur.
first_checks.why: A note prevents the next agent from repeating the same stale-anchor mistake.

decision_rules.condition: A handoff identifier cannot be verified as the current target.
decision_rules.then: Resolve the current target or create the correct anchor through the normal workflow before writing artifacts or status.

decision_rules.condition: A final migration or numbered artifact differs from the design note.
decision_rules.then: Update handoff/tests/docs to the final merged identifier and preserve the stale number only as historical context.

do_not: Do not attach work to a task, issue, or migration number solely because a handoff named it.
Do not leave stale design-note identifiers as the only searchable clue.
Do not ask a human to choose between IDs until the agent has resolved current status and purpose.

agent_directives.preferred_next_step: Resolve every execution identifier against current state, then record the final ID and any rejected stale ID before handoff.

risk.notes: This public record is de-identified. It does not authorize bypassing human, maintainer, security, publication, billing, data, or credential gates.

sources.excerpt: AI-session recovery guidance identified stale task anchors and default-mission drift as recurring sources of misplaced work.
sources.supports: Supports resolving handoff anchors before execution.

sources.excerpt: A migration filename can change after rebasing against main; future agents need the final merged identifier, not only the design-time number.
